prompt: A dense old-growth forest interior, towering moss-slicked oak trunks in deep emerald and bark-brown, a carpet of ferns and lichen on the forest floor. Golden crepuscular rays of warm sunlight filter down through the green canopy. The background is layers of receding trees fading into soft green haze. Lush, verdant, naturalistic.

A single colossal ancient tree with a broad gnarled trunk and sprawling deep-emerald canopy dominating the frame, moss and lichen on its bark, roots gripping a mossy forest floor. Warm sunlight breaks through the leaves. The background is a misty green woodland fading into haze. Lush and verdant.

A winding earthen footpath leading deep into a dense emerald forest, tall straight tree trunks flanking both sides, ferns crowding the path edges. Dappled golden light pools on the trail. The background is the path curving away into deep green shadow under the canopy. Lush, atmospheric woodland.

A sunlit forest clearing carpeted in bright green ferns and wildflowers, ringed by towering deep-emerald trees, a small mossy boulder at center. Bright crepuscular rays of warm sun stream down into the glade. The background is a dense wall of forest trees fading into green haze. Lush, vibrant, naturalistic.

A deep old-growth forest interior seen from the floor looking up, massive moss-slicked tree trunks rising on either side, dense deep-emerald canopy overhead. Bright golden crepuscular rays slant down between the trunks onto a fern-covered floor. The background is layered receding trees in green haze. Lush, verdant, atmospheric.

A single colossal ancient oak with a massive gnarled trunk and a vast deep-emerald canopy filling the upper frame, moss and lichen creeping up its bark, thick roots spreading over a fern-covered forest floor. Shafts of warm golden sunlight break through the leaves. The background is a hazy green woodland behind it. Lush, verdant, iconic.

A dense old-growth forest interior glowing with warm golden light, tall moss-slicked tree trunks in deep emerald and brown framing a bright sunlit gap in the canopy, ferns and undergrowth carpeting the floor. Crepuscular rays slant down through the leaves. The background is layered receding trees in soft green haze. Lush, verdant, atmospheric.

A lush riverside forest, a clear stream winding between deep-emerald mossy trees and fern banks, smooth wet stones in the water. Warm dappled sunlight falls through the canopy onto the stream. The background is dense green woodland fading into haze. Verdant, naturalistic, atmospheric.

A great solitary tree on a low grassy hill at the edge of a deep forest, broad deep-emerald canopy, thick mossy trunk, ferns at its base. Warm late-afternoon sunlight rakes across the scene casting long shadows. The background is a dense green treeline under a soft sky. Lush and verdant.
